tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens for scripts and automated services (like GitHub). Exchange a token for a JWT: POST /connect/token, grant_type=urn:tsl:grant-type:pat, client_id=tsl-pat, token=<token>. The JWT never has more permissions than you currently have.
